我们的定向爆破打开了一条通向我们之前未发现墓室的通路。这个空间深藏于封印之后，显然做了一些反盗墓的设计。它里面还充满了敌对的实体。

球体立刻拉动了锚链，但还是有许多守卫跟随着我们的尾流冲出了裂隙。
texts.en:
Our controlled explosion has opened the way to a previously undetected cavity. Hidden behind the seal, this space was clearly designed to counter intrusion. It was filled to the brim with hostile entities.

The Sphere immediately retrieved the anchor, but many of the guardians have exited the rift with us and are following in our wake.

label.zh: 现在我们有些麻烦要处理了。
label.en: We have a problem to deal with.
